title: Explicit p-adic Hodge theory for elliptic curves and non-split Cartan images
summary: Let $E/\mathbb{Q}_p$ be an elliptic curve whose mod $p$ Galois image is contained in the normaliser of a non-split Cartan. We classify the possible $p$-adic images of $E$ using tools from $p$-adic Hodge theory via a careful analysis of the local Galois structure of the $p$-power torsion of $E$.
